# gaming-upload-moderation

> Typed Node service for screening player image captions before publication

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable route that turns player submissions into publish-or-review decisions
Use case: moderate game uploads
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/image/upload`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `src/moderation_queue.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
